_notes: Wailing Caverns boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Lady Anacondra.name: Viperskin Bracers
Lady Anacondra.flavor_text: Bracers cut from a viper that made the mistake of being underfoot. They cool the pulse and sweeten the temper.

Lady Anacondra.name: Anacondra's Slumber-Staff
Lady Anacondra.flavor_text: A staff of green wood and cold scales. Whoever holds it gets very calm, very quickly.

Lady Anacondra.name: Serpentbloom Circlet
Lady Anacondra.flavor_text: A circlet of pale flowers that bloom only in the dark of the caverns. They smell of wet stone and sleep.

Lady Anacondra.name: Lady's Coiled Signet
Lady Anacondra.flavor_text: A thin gold ring coiled twice around the finger. It tightens when you lie, and Lady Anacondra never lied.

Lady Anacondra.name: Cavern Silt-Knuckles
Lady Anacondra.flavor_text: Packed with grit that will not wash out and is no longer meant to.
Lady Anacondra.label: Fist (Agi)

Lord Cobrahn.name: Cobrahn's Fanged Cleaver
Lord Cobrahn.flavor_text: A hand-axe with a fang set into the head. It bites, then it lets go. That is how snakes do it.

Lord Cobrahn.name: Emerald Scale Chestguard
Lord Cobrahn.flavor_text: Green scale-mail that shifts colour when you are not paying attention. It is always listening.

Lord Cobrahn.name: Drake-Hide Cloak
Lord Cobrahn.flavor_text: A long cloak cut from a drake's shed skin. It takes the wind well and the daylight poorly.

Lord Cobrahn.name: Venomtouched Waistband
Lord Cobrahn.flavor_text: Leather stained a permanent, unhealthy green. A careful wearer never licks a finger.

Kresh.name: Kresh's Shellplate Spaulders
Kresh.flavor_text: Pauldrons carved from an old turtle's shell, hammered flat. They take hits and give nothing back, which is the point.

Kresh.name: Barnacled Bulwark
Kresh.flavor_text: A shield grown over with barnacles. They are, oddly, still alive, and still clinging.

Kresh.name: Silt-Soaked Greaves
Kresh.flavor_text: Mail boots caked in river-silt. They keep a swimmer's footing and a waterlogged mood.

Kresh.name: Tidebound Band
Kresh.flavor_text: A ring of dull green shell. When you wear it you hear, very faintly, something stir.

Lord Pythas.name: Pythas's Thunderstaff
Lord Pythas.flavor_text: A staff that crackles. Pythas called down thunder to defend his sleeping chamber; the staff remembers.

Lord Pythas.name: Slumberer's Mantle
Lord Pythas.flavor_text: A soft mantle that drags every thought toward a nap. Practiced wearers learn to sleep upright and cast anyway.

Lord Pythas.name: Fang-Lord's Pale Dagger
Lord Pythas.flavor_text: A dagger of bleached bone. It is quiet even when it is not quiet.

Lord Pythas.name: Basin Walker's Boots
Lord Pythas.flavor_text: Leather boots laced with river-reed. They dry fast, and they walk soft.

Skum.name: Thunderhide Vest
Skum.flavor_text: A vest of thick lizard hide. Static lifts the hairs on your arms whenever you put it on.

Skum.name: Skum's Tail-Club
Skum.flavor_text: A great mace made from the tail-bone of something very large. It was not asked, and it did not volunteer.

Skum.name: Thunder-Tooth Pendant
Skum.flavor_text: A tooth the length of a thumb, hung on a cord. It hums a note just below hearing.

Skum.name: Static-Charged Gauntlets
Skum.flavor_text: Mail gauntlets that hum. If you clap in them, the cave notices.

Lord Serpentis.name: Serpentis's Venom-Wand
Lord Serpentis.flavor_text: A wand of petrified serpent spine. The tip beads with something you would rather not touch.

Lord Serpentis.name: Fang-Weave Leggings
Lord Serpentis.flavor_text: Cloth woven with fine green thread and shaped like scales. They shift when you walk, softly, like an exhale.

Lord Serpentis.name: Wrathbringer's Falchion
Lord Serpentis.flavor_text: A curved sword with a hooked tip. Serpentis drew it when his rites were interrupted, and was seldom interrupted twice.

Lord Serpentis.name: Crest of the Fang
Lord Serpentis.flavor_text: A leather cap crowned with a ridge of fang. It marks the wearer as a student of the Fang, which has implications.

Verdan the Everliving.name: Verdan's Rootbark Cuirass
Verdan the Everliving.flavor_text: Plate grown through with living root. It heals a little when sunlit, which in this cave means never.

Verdan the Everliving.name: Everliving Greatstaff
Verdan the Everliving.flavor_text: A polearm of ironwood that still puts out leaves. They are, regrettably, very sharp.

Verdan the Everliving.name: Bark-Wrapped Vambraces
Verdan the Everliving.flavor_text: Plate vambraces wrapped in bark. When struck, they sigh a little.

Verdan the Everliving.name: Living Vine Cord
Verdan the Everliving.flavor_text: A length of vine that tightens and slackens on its own. It will mend you, if you ask nicely.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Mutanus's Devouring Helm
Mutanus the Devourer.flavor_text: A helm with a jaw. The jaw does not close, but it does not entirely stay still.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Nightmare-Touched Staff
Mutanus the Devourer.flavor_text: A staff of dark wood and green light. It hums to itself, in a voice that sounds like someone sleeping.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Naralex's Dreamshroud
Mutanus the Devourer.flavor_text: A cloak the colour of a bad dream, light as a prayer. It remembers a druid who was kind.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Devourer's Nightbolt Crossbow
Mutanus the Devourer.flavor_text: A crossbow built around a jawbone. The bolts are carved from something that was once asleep.

Old Hissfang.name: Hissfang's Coil-Knife
Old Hissfang.flavor_text: A knife made from a single shed fang. It is exactly as sharp as a snake's apology.

Old Hissfang.name: Shedskin Gloves
Old Hissfang.flavor_text: Gloves that feel wrong and fit right. They were, once, someone else's skin.

Old Hissfang.name: Old Serpent's Eye-Ring
Old Hissfang.flavor_text: A ring set with a yellow slit-eye. It watches whatever you do not.

Drowsyroot the Dreamer.name: Drowsyroot Mantle
Drowsyroot the Dreamer.flavor_text: A mantle of woven root. Wearing it, you hear the whole cave breathe slowly in and out.

Drowsyroot the Dreamer.name: Dreamer's Rootmace
Drowsyroot the Dreamer.flavor_text: A rod of living root, pulsing in time with a slumbering heart.

Drowsyroot the Dreamer.name: Lullaby Pendant
Drowsyroot the Dreamer.flavor_text: A pendant of spun glass. It plays a very quiet tune, and it never repeats a note.

Sporeback the Bloated.name: Sporeback's Mushroom Cap
Sporeback the Bloated.flavor_text: A helm grown from the cap of a very large fungus. It is damp and pleasantly absurd.

Sporeback the Bloated.name: Puffball Knuckles
Sporeback the Bloated.flavor_text: Fist-bars of dried spore-sacs. They burst politely on impact.

Sporeback the Bloated.name: Spore-Dusted Ring
Sporeback the Bloated.flavor_text: A ring dusted with something that smells faintly of rain.
